findings.description: The policy grants ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* on Resource "*" to the svc_deploy user, giving broad administrative control over four services with no scoping to specific resources, actions, or conditions. This is a substantial privilege-escalation, data-exfiltration, and resource-destruction surface.

The output exports aws_iam_access_key.svc_deploy_key.encrypted_secret, writing the credential into Terraform state and any plan output or downstream consumer of the output, rather than keeping it in a secrets manager.
